profile.name: x40-store
profile.description: PZTestKit + the staged NutritionRevamp release copy (release/plan11-x40) + TKX_StudyFoods, fixture two, admin and bob, Nutrition off, DayLength 1, build 42.21.0 - x402a, Plan 11b Task 4 S4b1: the round trip's save, the reconnect decay, the stop window.

harness_commits.016dce05: a ghost run restores its carrier's macros; time.snapshot reports the true multiplier
harness_commits.07c27dc4: the store probe formats tiny magnitudes with tostring (Kahlua %g hangs below 1e-292)

meta.staging: python tools/release_pack.py stage mod/NutritionRevamp --out release/plan11-x40 (the controller, after Task 3c); the driver checks it and never stages
meta.chain_note: S4b2 (x402b_store.py) copies this run's <run>/server folder and boots it again (x260b's method); this session's end is W's server stop with admin online
meta.ring_note: a ring row is sampled inside EveryOneMinute before the mod's queue drains that minute
meta.decay_note: KIN.drain caps a gap's drain at K.satiety.MAX_GAP_M (60) game minutes in one-minute substeps, and K.satiety.mealClear clears M first-order on each, so M after the gap is M_q x exp(-lambda x min(D, 1 h)) exactly; lambda (ln 2 x trait / MEAL_HALF_LIFE_H) is measured on the ring
meta.stop_note: a dedicated server fires no Lua event around a stop (ruling T20-1): the eat reaches the file only through the dirty mark's next store step

RT_SAVE.void: the bus died at the save

RC_OFFLINE.every away ring row (on false): kineticsAge and satiety.M equal the away record's

RC_DECAY.M_1: M_q x exp(-lambda x min(D, 1 h)), lambda the median of the ring's online minute pairs
RC_DECAY.unmeasured: no lambda pair, no away record or no moved row after the rejoin
RC_DECAY.reported: the no-cap value and ln 2 / MEAL_HALF_LIFE_H (trait 1)

RC_CLAMP.with D > 1 h: RC_DECAY as predicted and the no-cap value off M_1 by more than 0.001

RC_T.satiety.t after the rejoin: >= the relaunch's world age and > the away record's t

W_ARMED.reading: the landing confirmed, the stop sent with admin online, the stop's server time under SAVE_GAP_MS after admin's last regular write; graded in S4b2 as STOPWIN

Z.server: answered its last read before the stop

deviations: store.probe bench and the slot size are dropped as owed reads (absorbed by x391h, #3757-#3761); the slot size is kept as a reading.

The stop window's stop follows one read past the read that confirms the landing (a game minute is 0.625 s and a server bus round trip about 1.3 s), with saved_at_confirm, saved_before_stop and the stop's server time against admin's last regular write recorded; the run sheet's 'within one game minute' is not reachable through the bus.
The reconnect's away wait AWAY_MIN_H is a driver choice so the offline gap passes the 60 game-minute cap.
RC eats TKX.Mixed650 and W TKX.Mixed400, so each phase's monotony entry is its own.
